concerns.text: FR-001 requires ≥ 95 % coverage of the curated dataset and mandates pipeline failure if coverage is lower. Task T002 treats coverage < 0.95 as a warning and allows downstream tasks to continue, which weakens the mandatory failure condition.

SC-001 specifies that the primary model must improve baseline R² by > 0.05. Task T007 only adds a warning field (`delta_r2_insufficient: true`) when ΔR² ≤ 0.05, allowing the pipeline to pass despite not meeting the success criterion, thus weakening the requirement.

FR-008 states that when removing high‑VIF descriptors, priority is to retain the weighted mean atomic radius and only drop the atomic size coefficient of variation if its VIF exceeds the threshold after the mean radius is kept. Task T003 drops *any* descriptor with VIF > 5 (except the mean radius) without the conditional check, potentially discarding the atomic size coefficient of variation even when its VIF is acceptable, thereby weakening the multicollinearity mitigation rule.

SC-003 requires feature‑importance rankings to be generated using SHAP values for linear regression and permutation importance for random forest. Task T009 implements linear‑regression importance via absolute standardized coefficients, not SHAP, deviating from the specified methodology and weakening the prescribed evaluation approach.
